guide.text: Ordinary and held-out subscription facts are synthetic stress scenarios, not representative customer behavior or real adopter usage evidence. This disposable, non-production review lab presents static rendering. Rendered controls do not establish completed billing actions. Static rendering verifies story state and visual/semantic output. It does not prove mounted authorization, provider completion, dispatched action behavior, or persistence. The review lab is a production operations console.

story.moduledoc: Every variation is a static render of deterministic scenario facts. It does not establish mounted authorization, provider completion, persistence, or action success.

entries.job: understand subscription state and choose a supported next action
